reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on the music system in Provincia! We’ve implemented a long equal-power self-crossfade for our day, night, title, and combat beds. This means no more hard cuts in the music, providing a smoother listening experience as you build your colony. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Improvements in Provincia
steam.body: We’re thrilled to announce an upgrade to the audio system in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat music beds now feature seamless transitions thanks to a long equal-power self-crossfade. This enhancement ensures a more immersive experience as you build and manage your colony. For more information, check out our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
